name: Jashubi-lehem
overview: Jashubi-lehem is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Shelah, who himself is a son of Judah. This lineage places him within the important genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, emphasizing his tribal heritage and family connection. No additional notes are recorded about him beyond this genealogical detail.
namesAndTitles: The name Jashubi-lehem means '[they] returned to Lehem,' reflecting a proper name given to this individual. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God but is recorded in Scripture, specifically in 1 Chronicles 4:22.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Jashubi-lehem is the son of Shelah, who is a son of Judah. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are documented in the biblical text concerning him.
scriptureSignificance: Jashubi-lehem's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical lineage of Judah, which is foundational for understanding the ancestry of the tribe from which the Messiah, Jesus Christ, would ultimately come. His mention in 1 Chronicles 4:22 helps preserve the historical and tribal records essential for God's unfolding redemptive plan through the line of Judah.
